import sys
from collections import Counter

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(input[0])
    word = list(input[1])
    vals = list(map(int, input[2].split()))
    
    badones = [0]*26
    m = 0
    for i in range(n // 2):
        if word[i] == word[n - i - 1]:
            badones[ord(word[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
            m +=1

    max_bad = 0
    bad = False
    val = -1
    for i in range(26):
        if badones[i]*2 > m:
            bad = True
            val = i

    if not bad:
        total_sum = 0
        for i in range(n // 2):
            if word[i] != word[n - i - 1]:
                total_sum += vals[i] + vals[n - i - 1]
            else:
                total_sum += max(vals[i], vals[n - i - 1])
        print(total_sum)
    else:
        others = badones[val] - (m - badones[val])
        appr = []
        for i in range(n // 2):
            if (word[i] != word[n - i - 1] and 
                ord(word[i]) - ord('a') != val and 
                ord(word[n - i - 1]) - ord('a') != val):
                appr.append(min(vals[i], vals[n - i - 1]))
        appr.sort()
        ans = 0
        for i in range(n // 2):
            if word[i] == word[n - i - 1]:
                ans += max(vals[i], vals[n - i - 1])
            else:
                ans += vals[i] + vals[n - i - 1]
        for i in range(others):
            ans -= appr[i]
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
